functions.author: Moolah
functions.title: Moolah Guide
pages:
§lWelcome to Moolah!§r

Moolah stores real diamond value digitally.

1 diamond = 100 Moolah

Open the main menu with §l/bank§r or Use a diamond.

§lDeposit§r

Turn inventory diamonds into Moolah.

§l/deposit§r opens the menu.
§l/deposit 1-1728§r deposits that many.
§l/deposit 0§r deposits all.

§lWithdraw§r

Turn Moolah back into diamonds.

§l/withdraw§r opens the menu. Use 1-1728 or 0 for All to open a confirmation showing the total and any tax.

§lTransfers§r

Use §l/pay§r to send Moolah. Payments stay Pending until accepted, so senders may cancel them.

Use §l/inbox§r and §l/pending§r for shortcuts.

§lMail§r

Use §l/mail§r to message online or offline players. Postage may apply.

Opening mail accepts it. The sender may cancel it only while it is still unopened.

§lQuickPay Signs§r

Line 1: !QuickPay
Line 2: USERNAME
Line 3: AMOUNT
Line 4: DESCRIPTION

Use a registered sign to create a payment. Always verify its details.

§lMarket§r

Use §l/market§r to browse or manage listings.

§l/buy§r opens browsing.
§l/sell§r lists your held item.

Fees and taxes may apply.

§lWarp§r

When enabled, use §l/warp§r to travel to a player, Spawn, or Home.

Distance and dimension affect price. You always see a confirmation first.

§lHelpful Notes§r

Hold a diamond to see your balance. Use §l/taxes§r to check the Tax Pool and your next return.

Features and fees depend on world settings. For conflicts, prefix commands with §lmoolah:§r.
